issue_context.title: [BUG] Recording of multi select component leads to non-compiling code (filter/LocatorOptions)
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.28.1
- Operating System: Windows
- Browser: Chrome

Hi,

We are using a multi select component within our application. The recording of said component results in non-compiling Java code though. The recorded Java code is

```java
page.locator("span").filter(new Locator.LocatorOptions().setHasText("mytext")).first().click();
```

As _LocatorOptions_ is not compatible with the _filter_-method (it expects a _FilterOption_), the code does not compile.

review_comments: Having an extra symbol is the point of this test (see the comment at line 372).
